pages.text: The Blue Orb in your inventory opens Race Information.$(br2)Use it to inspect and customize how your racial traits appear.
Toggle Show Trait to hide or show your racial features.$(br2)Choose a trait style or variant, adjust trait colors, and flip the preview to inspect your character.

Select the Race Information button to view your race attributes and active abilities.$(br2)Choose an ability to read its description and source. Active abilities can come from your race, trinkets, and other sources.$(br2)The Mana Bar button opens its layout options.
